desc: Factor all A_i and build per-prime event lists (edge index, exponent) plus total exponent T_p.
Implement the per-prime bounded-walk DP that computes G_T and G_{T-1} simultaneously, with zero-run diagonal scaling, ±a transitions, active ranges, and efficient modular arithmetic.
Combine prime factors as F_p = G_T - p^N G_{T-1} mod 998244353 (F_p=1 if T_p=0) and print the product.
Verify on samples 1-3 and small random brute-force cross-checks.
